{{uitech}}
:::''These templates are defined in <code>[https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/SecureHandlerTemplates.xml FrameXML/SecureHandlerTemplates.xml]</code> and <code>[https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/SecureHandlers.lua FrameXML/SecureHandlers.lua]''</code>
'''SecureHandlers''' (created by [[Virtual XML template|inheriting]] '''SecureHandlerBaseTemplate''') use code snippets inside the [[RestrictedEnvironment]].  Each snippet is a {{api|t=t|string}} that behaves like the body of a Lua function, but it can only contain a subset of the [[World of Warcraft API]].

== Defined methods ==
* {{api|t=w|SecureHandlerBaseTemplate:Execute(body)}}  - Executes a code snippet in the restricted environment.
* {{api|t=w|SecureHandlerBaseTemplate:WrapScript(header, script, preBody [, postBody])}} - Wraps a widget script with code snippets executed in the restricted environment.
* {{api|t=w|SecureHandlerBaseTemplate:UnwrapScript(frame, script)}} - Strips (and returns) the outermost-wrapped handler.
* {{api|t=w|SecureHandlerBaseTemplate:SetFrameRef(id, refFrame)}} - Creates a frame reference accessible in the restricted environment.

== Details ==
* The base template has an OnLoad widget script which adds the four defined methods.
* Other templates (listed below) use {{api|t=w|Frame:SetAttribute}}() to run [[widget script handlers]] in the RestrictedEnvironment.

{| class="darktable"
! Template !! Description !! Attribute (<span class="apiarg">arguments</span>)
|-
| '''SecureHandlerBaseTemplate''' || Enables common methods on the frame || ''none''
|-
| [[SecureHandlerStateTemplate]] || Only "state-''xxx''" attribute changes || '''_onstate-''xxx'''''(<span class="apiarg">self, stateid, newstate</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerAttributeTemplate]] || Any attribute change || '''_onattributechanged'''(<span class="apiarg">self, name, value</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerClickTemplate]] || Clicks || '''_onclick'''(<span class="apiarg">self, button, down</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerDoubleClickTemplate]] || Double clicks || '''_ondoubleclick'''(<span class="apiarg">self, button, down</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerDragTemplate]] || Dragging || '''_ondragstart'''(<span class="apiarg">self, button</span>), '''_onreceivedrag'''(<span class="apiarg">self, button, kind, value, ...</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerMouseUpDownTemplate]] || Mouse up/down || '''_onmouseup'''(<span class="apiarg">self, button</span>), '''_onmousedown'''(<span class="apiarg">self, button</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerMouseWheelTemplate]] || Mouse wheel || '''_onmousewheel'''(<span class="apiarg">self, delta</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerEnterLeaveTemplate]] || Mouse entering/leaving || '''_onenter'''(<span class="apiarg">self</span>), '''_onleave'''(<span class="apiarg">self</span>)
|-
| [[SecureHandlerShowHideTemplate]] || Frame shown/hidden || '''_onshow'''(<span class="apiarg">self</span>), '''_onhide'''(<span class="apiarg">self</span>)
|}

== Example ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
local frame = CreateFrame("Frame", nil, "SecureHandlerClickTemplate")
frame:SetAttribute("_onclick", [=[
	-- self, button, down
	if button == "RightButton" then
		self:Hide();
	end
]=])
</syntaxhighlight>
